features: Controlled single-node HTML5 drag and drop with destination feedback
Accessible move up/down and JSON Pointer destination form
Same-container and cross-container moves preserve subtree IDs
Cycle, root, name collision, type, depth and revision guards
Ordinal object-key and homogeneous scalar-array stable sorting
Exact decimal numeric comparison without Number coercion
Verified scalar range projection update and compact Worker response
Stable minimal tree topology with mounted-row value subscriptions
limitations: Drag tests dispatch standard DOM HTML5 events; native Windows mouse automation did not complete and physical drag was not manually verified
Arrays sort automatically only when elements have the same scalar type
Array-to-object move needs an explicit key through the form
Scalar fast path requires exact source/version and unchanged structure/key; other edits use strict full parsing
Range and ID index work remains linear; topology/selection/resize changes may rebuild Arborist indices
Performance uses synthetic flat arrays, one paste and three sequential edits per size, with no randomized comparison or fixed GC
Affected structural containers may change whitespace layout; unmodified value and key literal slices are preserved
notPerformed: Phase6 file open/save and persistence or OS clipboard APIs
Installer execution, uninstall, upgrade, signing and publishing
